OUR EXTENSION

And beyond 9,999?

Add another symbol to the left, just as you add another digit. Each symbol holds a group of four digits.

12,345,678→1234│5678

Read left to right: 1,234 × 10,000 + 5,678. More symbols let you go higher still.

A note on notation. The four-corner symbols follow the supplied chart. Grouping symbols above 9,999, an empty stem for zero, minus signs and fraction bars are conventions used in this app.
